AI.title_translation: 使用 Gemini 进行半自主数学发现：以 Erdős 问题为例的案例研究
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用 Gemini AI 模型系统评估了 700 个 Erdős 问题的未解决猜想。通过混合方法解决了其中 13 个问题，包括 5 个新的自主解决方案和 8 个已存在文献解决方案的识别。研究表明这些问题的“未解决”状态是由于模糊性而非难度。同时，论文讨论了 AI 在大规模数学猜想应用中的挑战，例如文献识别困难和“潜意识剽窃”的风险。
AI.motivation: 系统地评估 Bloom 的 Erdős 问题数据库中标记为“开放”（Open）的 700 个猜想，旨在利用 AI 协助进行半自主数学发现。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：首先，使用 AI（Gemini）驱动的自然语言验证来缩小搜索空间；其次，由人类专家进行评估，以判断解决方案的正确性和新颖性。
AI.result: 共解决了数据库中 13 个标记为“开放”的问题。其中 5 个问题通过看似新颖的自主解决方案解决，8 个问题通过识别现有文献中的先前解决方案解决。研究结果表明，这些问题的“开放”状态是由于模糊性（obscurity）而非难度（difficulty）。
AI.conclusion: 这些 Erdős 问题的“开放”状态是由于问题的模糊性而不是难度。论文还对 AI 辅助解决 Erdős 问题的经验教训进行了反思，并讨论了大规模应用 AI 于数学猜想时面临的挑战，如文献识别困难和 AI 产生“潜意识剽窃”的风险。
AI.translation: 我们展示了一个半自主数学发现的案例研究，使用 Gemini 系统地评估了 Bloom 的 Erdős 问题数据库中标记为“开放”的 700 个猜想。我们采用了一种混合方法：AI 驱动的自然语言验证用于缩小搜索空间，随后由人类专家进行评估以衡量正确性和新颖性。我们解决了数据库中标记为“开放”的 13 个问题：5 个通过看似新颖的自主解决方案解决，8 个通过识别现有文献中的先前解决方案解决。我们的发现表明，这些问题的“开放”状态是由于模糊性而非难度。我们还识别并讨论了将 AI 大规模应用于数学猜想时出现的问题，强调了文献识别的难度以及 AI 产生“潜意识剽窃”的风险。我们反思了 AI 辅助解决 Erdős 问题的经验教训。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一项利用 Gemini 模型进行半自主数学发现的案例研究，重点评估了 Bloom 的 Erdős 问题数据库中 700 个标记为“开放”的猜想。通过 AI 验证和人类专家评估的混合方法，研究解决了 13 个未解决问题，包括提供 5 个新颖的自主解决方案和识别 8 个现有文献中的解决方案。研究得出结论，这些问题的“开放”状态更多是源于其模糊性。此外，文章探讨了大规模使用 AI 解决数学猜想时面临的挑战，特别是文献识别和 AI 潜在的“潜意识剽窃”问题。
AI.keywords: 半自主数学发现, Gemini, Erdős 问题, 猜想验证, 潜意识剽窃
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM，即 Gemini）应用于系统性的、大规模的数学猜想验证，而不仅仅是生成证明。其重要性体现在展示了 AI 在帮助缩小数学研究空间方面的巨大潜力，特别是在处理那些因信息模糊而非内在难度而未解决的问题。同时，论文坦诚地指出了应用 AI 的关键限制，如文献识别的难度以及“潜意识剽窃”这一伦理和技术风险，为未来 AI 辅助数学研究提供了重要的警示和研究方向。

title: Non-Intrusive Graph-Based Bot Detection for E-Commerce Using Inductive Graph Neural Networks
summary: Malicious bots pose a growing threat to e-commerce platforms by scraping data, hoarding inventory, and perpetrating fraud. Traditional bot mitigation techniques, including IP blacklists and CAPTCHA-based challenges, are increasingly ineffective or intrusive, as modern bots leverage proxies, botnets, and AI-assisted evasion strategies. This work proposes a non-intrusive graph-based bot detection framework for e-commerce that models user session behavior through a graph representation and applies an inductive graph neural network for classification. The approach captures both relational structure and behavioral semantics, enabling accurate identification of subtle automated activity that evades feature-based methods. Experiments on real-world e-commerce traffic demonstrate that the proposed inductive graph model outperforms a strong session-level multilayer perceptron baseline in terms of AUC and F1 score. Additional adversarial perturbation and cold-start simulations show that the model remains robust under moderate graph modifications and generalizes effectively to previously unseen sessions and URLs. The proposed framework is deployment-friendly, integrates with existing systems without client-side instrumentation, and supports real-time inference and incremental updates, making it suitable for practical e-commerce security deployments.

AI.title_translation: 使用归纳图神经网络的电商非侵入式图基机器人检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种使用归纳图神经网络（GNN）的非侵入式图基框架，用于检测电商平台上的恶意机器人，该框架在真实数据上表现优于基线，且具有鲁棒性和部署友好性。
AI.motivation: 恶意机器人对电商平台构成日益增长的威胁（数据抓取、囤积库存、欺诈）。传统的机器人缓解技术（如IP黑名单、CAPTCHA）因现代机器人利用代理、僵尸网络和AI规避策略而变得无效或具有侵入性。
AI.method: 提出了一种非侵入式的图基机器人检测框架。该方法将用户会话行为建模为图表示，并应用归纳图神经网络（Inductive GNN）进行分类。它捕获关系结构和行为语义，以识别微妙的自动化活动。
AI.result: 在真实电商流量上的实验表明，所提出的归纳图模型在AUC和F1分数方面优于强大的会话级多层感知器（MLP）基线。额外的对抗性扰动和冷启动模拟显示，该模型在中等图修改下仍保持鲁棒性，并能有效地泛化到以前未见的会话和URL。
AI.conclusion: 该框架部署友好，无需客户端插桩即可与现有系统集成，并支持实时推理和增量更新，因此适用于实际的电商安全部署。
AI.translation: 恶意机器人通过抓取数据、囤积库存和实施欺诈，对电子商务平台构成了日益增长的威胁。传统的机器人缓解技术，包括IP黑名单和基于CAPTCHA的挑战，正变得越来越无效或具有侵入性，因为现代机器人利用代理、僵尸网络和AI辅助规避策略。这项工作提出了一种用于电子商务的非侵入式图基机器人检测框架，该框架通过图表示对用户会话行为进行建模，并应用归纳图神经网络进行分类。该方法捕获了关系结构和行为语义，能够准确识别规避基于特征方法的微妙自动化活动。在真实世界的电子商务流量上进行的实验表明，所提出的归纳图模型在AUC和F1分数方面优于强大的会话级多层感知器基线。额外的对抗性扰动和冷启动模拟表明，该模型在中等图修改下仍保持鲁棒性，并能有效地泛化到以前未见的会话和URL。所提出的框架部署友好，无需客户端插桩即可与现有系统集成，并支持实时推理和增量更新，使其适用于实际的电子商务安全部署。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统机器人检测方法在电商环境中失效或侵入性的问题，提出了一种非侵入式的图基机器人检测框架。该框架将用户会话行为表示为图，并利用归纳图神经网络（GNN）进行分类，以同时捕捉关系结构和行为语义。实验证明，该模型在真实电商数据上，其性能（AUC和F1分数）优于基线MLP模型，并展示了对对抗性攻击和冷启动场景的鲁棒性与泛化能力。该框架具有部署友好性，支持实时和增量更新。
AI.keywords: 机器人检测, 归纳图神经网络, 电子商务安全, 非侵入式
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将归纳图神经网络（Inductive GNN）应用于非侵入式的电商机器人检测，有效地利用了用户会话间的关系结构，解决了传统基于特征或会话的方法难以捕捉的微妙自动化行为。强调“非侵入式”和“部署友好”解决了实际应用中传统方法（如CAPTCHA）带来的用户体验问题，使其具有较高的实用价值。归纳性是关键，因为它保证了模型能够泛化到未见过的新的机器人策略和会话数据，这对于快速变化的机器人规避技术至关重要。

title: PEAR: Pixel-aligned Expressive humAn mesh Recovery
summary: Reconstructing detailed 3D human meshes from a single in-the-wild image remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. Existing SMPLX-based methods often suffer from slow inference, produce only coarse body poses, and exhibit misalignments or unnatural artifacts in fine-grained regions such as the face and hands. These issues make current approaches difficult to apply to downstream tasks. To address these challenges, we propose PEAR-a fast and robust framework for pixel-aligned expressive human mesh recovery. PEAR explicitly tackles three major limitations of existing methods: slow inference, inaccurate localization of fine-grained human pose details, and insufficient facial expression capture. Specifically, to enable real-time SMPLX parameter inference, we depart from prior designs that rely on high resolution inputs or multi-branch architectures. Instead, we adopt a clean and unified ViT-based model capable of recovering coarse 3D human geometry. To compensate for the loss of fine-grained details caused by this simplified architecture, we introduce pixel-level supervision to optimize the geometry, significantly improving the reconstruction accuracy of fine-grained human details. To make this approach practical, we further propose a modular data annotation strategy that enriches the training data and enhances the robustness of the model. Overall, PEAR is a preprocessing-free framework that can simultaneously infer EHM-s (SMPLX and scaled-FLAME) parameters at over 100 FPS. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method achieves substantial improvements in pose estimation accuracy compared to previous SMPLX-based approaches. Project page: https://wujh2001.github.io/PEAR

AI.title_translation: PEAR：像素对齐的富有表现力的人体网格恢复
AI.tldr: 现有3D人体网格恢复方法慢且细节不准确。我们提出了PEAR，一个基于ViT的快速（100+ FPS）、鲁棒的框架，使用像素级监督从单张图像中恢复富有表现力的、细节准确的人体网格。
AI.motivation: 从单张野外图像中重建细节丰富的3D人体网格是一个基本挑战。现有的基于SMPLX的方法存在推理慢、身体姿态粗糙、以及在面部和手部等精细区域出现错位或不自然伪影的问题，难以应用于下游任务。
AI.method:
提出了PEAR框架，用于像素对齐的富有表现力的人体网格恢复。
1. 为了实现实时SMPLX参数推理，放弃了依赖高分辨率输入或多分支架构的先前设计。
2. 采用了一个简洁统一的基于ViT的模型来恢复粗糙的3D人体几何结构。
3. 引入像素级监督来优化几何结构，显著提高精细人体细节的重建精度。
4. 提出了一种模块化数据标注策略，以丰富训练数据并增强模型的鲁棒性。
AI.result: PEAR是一个无需预处理的框架，可以同时以超过100 FPS的速度推断EHM-s（SMPLX和scaled-FLAME）参数。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，与以前基于SMPLX的方法相比，该方法在姿态估计精度方面取得了实质性改进。
AI.conclusion: PEAR是一个快速且鲁棒的框架，通过采用简化的ViT架构、像素级监督和数据增强策略，解决了现有方法的推理速度慢和细节精度低的问题，实现了超过100 FPS的实时性能，并在姿态估计精度上取得了显著提升。
AI.translation: 从单张野外图像中重建细节丰富的3D人体网格仍然是计算机视觉中的一个基本挑战。现有的基于SMPLX的方法通常存在推理缓慢、仅能产生粗糙的身体姿态，并且在面部和手部等精细区域表现出错位或不自然的伪影。这些问题使得现有方法难以应用于下游任务。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了PEAR——一个用于像素对齐的富有表现力的人体网格恢复的快速且鲁棒的框架。PEAR明确地解决了现有方法的三大局限性：推理慢、精细人体姿态细节定位不准确以及面部表情捕获不足。具体来说，为了实现实时SMPLX参数推理，我们摒弃了依赖高分辨率输入或多分支架构的先前设计。相反，我们采用了一个简洁统一的基于ViT的模型，能够恢复粗糙的3D人体几何结构。为了弥补这种简化架构导致的精细细节损失，我们引入了像素级监督来优化几何结构，显著提高了精细人体细节的重建精度。为了使这种方法实用化，我们进一步提出了一种模块化数据标注策略，以丰富训练数据并增强模型的鲁棒性。总而言之，PEAR是一个无需预处理的框架，可以同时以超过100 FPS的速度推断EHM-s（SMPLX和scaled-FLAME）参数。在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，与以前基于SMPLX的方法相比，我们的方法在姿态估计精度方面取得了实质性改进。项目页面：https://wujh2001.github.io/PEAR
AI.summary: 本文提出了PEAR框架，旨在解决现有基于SMPLX的3D人体网格恢复方法中存在的推理速度慢和精细细节（如面部和手部）重建不准确的问题。PEAR采用了一种简洁统一的基于ViT的架构，放弃了高分辨率或多分支设计，从而实现了超过100 FPS的实时推理速度。为了弥补架构简化带来的细节损失，该方法引入了像素级监督来优化几何结构，并结合模块化数据标注策略来增强鲁棒性。实验证明，PEAR在姿态估计精度上显著优于现有基于SMPLX的方法。
AI.keywords: PEAR, SMPLX, ViT, 像素对齐, 实时人体网格恢复
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于平衡了人体网格恢复的速度和精度。通过采用简洁统一的基于ViT的架构，PEAR首次实现了超过100 FPS的实时SMPLX参数推断，极大地提高了实用性。同时，通过引入像素级监督来弥补架构简化导致的细节损失，显著改善了面部和手部等精细区域的重建精度。这种对实时性和精细细节的兼顾，使其在下游任务中具有重要的应用潜力。

title: Avoiding Premature Collapse: Adaptive Annealing for Entropy-Regularized Structural Inference
summary: Differentiable matching layers and residual connection paradigms, often implemented via entropy-regularized Optimal Transport (OT), serve as critical mechanisms in structural prediction and architectural scaling. However, recovering discrete permutations or maintaining identity mappings via annealing $ε\to 0$ is notoriously unstable. In this work, we identify a fundamental mechanism for this failure: \textbf{Premature Mode Collapse}. By analyzing the non-normal dynamics of the Sinkhorn fixed-point map, we reveal a theoretical thermodynamic speed limit: standard exponential cooling outpaces the contraction rate of the inference operator, which degrades as $O(1/ε)$. To address this, we propose \textbf{Efficient Piecewise Hybrid Adaptive Stability Control (EPH-ASC)}, an adaptive scheduling algorithm that monitors the stability of the inference process. We demonstrate that EPH-ASC is essential for stabilizing Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) during large-scale training on the FineWeb-Edu dataset, effectively preventing late-stage gradient explosions by enforcing a linear stability law.

AI.title_translation: 避免过早崩溃：用于熵正则化结构推断的自适应退火
AI.tldr: 针对熵正则化结构推断中退火过程的不稳定问题（过早模式崩溃），本文提出了自适应调度算法EPH-ASC，通过监控推断稳定性来防止梯度爆炸，从而稳定大规模训练。
AI.motivation: 现有的微分匹配层和残差连接范式（通常通过熵正则化最优传输OT实现）在通过退火($\epsilon \to 0$)恢复离散排列或保持恒等映射时存在严重的不稳定性问题，即“过早模式崩溃”。标准的指数冷却速度超过了推断算子的收缩率，导致系统不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了高效分段混合自适应稳定性控制（Efficient Piecewise Hybrid Adaptive Stability Control, EPH-ASC）算法。该算法通过分析Sinkhorn不动点映射的非正常动力学，识别出理论热力学速度限制，并作为一种自适应调度机制来监控推断过程的稳定性，强制执行线性稳定性定律。
AI.result: EPH-ASC对于稳定大规模训练（在FineWeb-Edu数据集上）中的流形约束超连接（mHC）至关重要，能有效防止后期阶段的梯度爆炸。
AI.translation: 可微分匹配层和残差连接范式，通常通过熵正则化最优传输（OT）实现，是结构预测和架构扩展中的关键机制。然而，通过退火$\epsilon\to 0$来恢复离散排列或保持恒等映射是出了名的不稳定。在这项工作中，我们确定了这种失败的一个基本机制：**过早模式崩溃**。通过分析Sinkhorn不动点映射的非正常动力学，我们揭示了一个理论热力学速度限制：标准的指数冷却速度超过了推断算子的收缩率，该收缩率以$O(1/\epsilon)$的速度退化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了**高效分段混合自适应稳定性控制（EPH-ASC）**，这是一种监控推断过程稳定性的自适应调度算法。我们证明了EPH-ASC对于在FineWeb-Edu数据集上进行大规模训练期间稳定流形约束超连接（mHC）至关重要，通过强制执行线性稳定性定律，有效防止了后期阶段的梯度爆炸。
AI.summary: 本文研究了熵正则化最优传输（OT）中退火过程的不稳定性问题，将其归因于“过早模式崩溃”。通过理论分析Sinkhorn映射的非正常动力学，作者发现标准指数冷却速度过快，超过了$O(1/\epsilon)$的收缩率。为解决此问题，论文提出了EPH-ASC自适应调度算法，该算法通过监控稳定性并实施线性稳定性定律，成功稳定了大规模训练中的流形约束超连接（mHC），有效避免了梯度爆炸。
AI.keywords: 熵正则化最优传输, 自适应退火, 过早模式崩溃, 结构推断, EPH-ASC
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于将最优传输（OT）中的实际工程稳定性问题与严格的理论分析（Sinkhorn映射的非正常动力学和热力学速度限制）联系起来。通过识别“过早模式崩溃”这一根本机制，并提出EPH-ASC这一具有理论基础的自适应调度方法，为结构推断和大规模模型训练中的微分匹配层提供了一个关键的稳定化工具。这对于依赖软匹配进行梯度传播的现代深度学习架构具有重要的实际意义。

title: MeshGraphNet-Transformer: Scalable Mesh-based Learned Simulation for Solid Mechanics
summary:
We present MeshGraphNet-Transformer (MGN-T), a novel architecture that combines the global modeling capabilities of Transformers with the geometric inductive bias of MeshGraphNets, while preserving a mesh-based graph representation. MGN-T overcomes a key limitation of standard MGN, the inefficient long-range information propagation caused by iterative message passing on large, high-resolution meshes. A physics-attention Transformer serves as a global processor, updating all nodal states simultaneously while explicitly retaining node and edge attributes. By directly capturing long-range physical interactions, MGN-T eliminates the need for deep message-passing stacks or hierarchical, coarsened meshes, enabling efficient learning on high-resolution meshes with varying geometries, topologies, and boundary conditions at an industrial scale.
  We demonstrate that MGN-T successfully handles industrial-scale meshes for impact dynamics, a setting in which standard MGN fails due message-passing under-reaching. The method accurately models self-contact, plasticity, and multivariate outputs, including internal, phenomenological plastic variables. Moreover, MGN-T outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on classical benchmarks, achieving higher accuracy while maintaining practical efficiency, using only a fraction of the parameters required by competing baselines.

AI.title_translation: MeshGraphNet-Transformer：用于固体力学的可扩展基于网格的学习模拟
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的架构MeshGraphNet-Transformer (MGN-T)，它将Transformer的全局建模能力与MeshGraphNet的几何归纳偏置相结合。MGN-T通过引入物理注意力Transformer来解决标准MGN在处理大规模网格时信息传播效率低的问题，实现了对工业级网格的高效、准确模拟，性能优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 标准MeshGraphNet (MGN) 在处理大型、高分辨率网格时，由于迭代消息传递导致的低效长程信息传播（即消息传递不足），存在关键局限性。开发MGN-T旨在克服这一限制，实现对工业规模网格的高效学习。
AI.method: 提出MeshGraphNet-Transformer (MGN-T)，它结合了Transformer的全局建模能力和MeshGraphNet的几何归纳偏置，同时保留了基于网格的图表示。核心是使用一个“物理注意力Transformer”作为全局处理器，同时更新所有节点状态，并明确保留节点和边的属性，从而直接捕获长程物理交互。
AI.result: MGN-T成功处理了冲击动力学中的工业规模网格，解决了标准MGN因消息传递不足而失败的问题。该方法准确地模拟了自接触、塑性和多元输出（包括内部现象学塑性变量）。此外，MGN-T在经典基准测试中优于现有最先进方法，实现了更高的精度，同时保持了实用效率，且所需的参数量仅为竞争基线的零头。
AI.translation: 我们提出了MeshGraphNet-Transformer (MGN-T)，这是一种新颖的架构，它将Transformer的全局建模能力与MeshGraphNet的几何归纳偏置相结合，同时保留了基于网格的图表示。MGN-T克服了标准MGN的一个关键局限性，即在大型、高分辨率网格上由于迭代消息传递导致的低效长程信息传播。一个物理注意力Transformer充当全局处理器，同时更新所有节点状态，同时明确保留节点和边的属性。通过直接捕获长程物理交互，MGN-T消除了对深层消息传递堆栈或分层粗化网格的需求，从而能够以工业规模高效地学习具有不同几何形状、拓扑结构和边界条件的高分辨率网格。我们证明了MGN-T成功处理了冲击动力学中的工业规模网格，而标准MGN在这种设置下会因消息传递不足而失败。该方法准确地模拟了自接触、塑性以及多元输出，包括内部的现象学塑性变量。此外，MGN-T在经典基准测试中优于现有最先进方法，实现了更高的精度，同时保持了实用效率，且所需的参数量仅为竞争基线的零头。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MeshGraphNet-Transformer (MGN-T) 架构，它将Transformer的全局建模能力与MeshGraphNet的几何优势相结合，以提高学习模拟的效率和可扩展性。MGN-T使用物理注意力Transformer作为全局处理器，直接捕获长程物理交互，解决了标准MGN在处理高分辨率、工业规模网格时消息传递不足的问题。实验证明，MGN-T能够准确模拟冲击动力学中的自接触和塑性等复杂现象，并在基准测试中以更少的参数量实现了更高的精度，证明了其在固体力学模拟中的实用性和优越性。
AI.keywords: MeshGraphNet-Transformer, 学习模拟, 固体力学, 全局建模, 图神经网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将图神经网络（GNN）的局部几何偏置与Transformer的全局建模能力进行融合，这对于克服GNN在处理大规模物理系统时信息传播受限于局部邻域的固有瓶颈至关重要。通过引入“物理注意力”机制，MGN-T避免了传统的深层消息传递堆栈或复杂的网格层次结构，显著提高了在大规模工业应用（如冲击动力学）中的效率和准确性。MGN-T在保持高精度的同时，大幅减少了参数数量，这显示了该架构在实际部署中的巨大潜力。

title: Investigating the Impact of Histopathological Foundation Models on Regressive Prediction of Homologous Recombination Deficiency
summary: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale histopathology data have found great success in various fields of computational pathology, but their impact on regressive biomarker prediction remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate histopathological foundation models for regression-based tasks, demonstrated through the prediction of homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) score - a critical biomarker for personalized cancer treatment. Within multiple instance learning frameworks, we extract patch-level features from whole slide images (WSI) using five state-of-the-art foundation models, and evaluate their impact compared to contrastive learning-based features. Models are trained to predict continuous HRD scores based on these extracted features across breast, endometrial, and lung cancer cohorts from two public medical data collections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that models trained on foundation model features consistently outperform the baseline in terms of predictive accuracy and generalization capabilities while exhibiting systematic differences among the foundation models. Additionally, we propose a distribution-based upsampling strategy to mitigate target imbalance in these datasets, significantly improving the recall and balanced accuracy for underrepresented but clinically important patient populations. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of different sampling strategies and instance bagsizes by ablation studies. Our results highlight the benefits of large-scale histopathological pretraining for more precise and transferable regressive biomarker prediction, showcasing its potential to advance AI-driven precision oncology.

AI.title_translation: 调查组织病理学基础模型对同源重组缺陷回归预测的影响
AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了组织病理学基础模型在预测同源重组缺陷（HRD）分数这一回归任务上的表现。结果显示，基于基础模型特征的预测模型在准确性和泛化性上均优于基线模型，且提出的上采样策略能有效改善对少数群体的预测性能，证明了大规模预训练对于精准生物标志物预测的益处。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在计算病理学领域取得了巨大成功，但它们对回归性生物标志物预测任务的影响尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在系统评估组织病理学基础模型在预测同源重组缺陷（HRD）分数这一关键回归任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 1. 采用多实例学习（MIL）框架，使用五种最先进的基础模型从全玻片图像（WSI）中提取补丁级特征。2. 将基础模型特征与基于对比学习的特征（基线）进行比较评估。3. 模型在乳腺癌、子宫内膜癌和肺癌队列中训练以预测连续的HRD分数。4. 提出了一种基于分布的上采样策略来缓解数据集中的目标不平衡问题。5. 通过消融实验研究了不同采样策略和实例袋大小的影响。
AI.result: 1. 使用基础模型特征训练的模型在预测准确性和泛化能力方面始终优于基线模型。2. 不同的基础模型之间表现出系统性差异。3. 提出的基于分布的上采样策略显著提高了对代表性不足但具有临床重要性的患者群体的召回率和平衡准确率。
AI.conclusion: 大规模组织病理学预训练有利于实现更精确、更具可迁移性的回归生物标志物预测，展示了其推动人工智能驱动的精准肿瘤学的潜力。
AI.translation: 在基于大规模组织病理学数据上预训练的基础模型已在计算病理学的各个领域取得了巨大成功，但它们对回归性生物标志物预测的影响仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们通过预测同源重组缺陷（HRD）分数——一种用于个性化癌症治疗的关键生物标志物——来系统性评估组织病理学基础模型在基于回归任务中的表现。在多实例学习框架内，我们使用五种最先进的基础模型从全玻片图像（WSI）中提取补丁级特征，并评估它们与基于对比学习的特征相比所产生的影响。模型经过训练，基于从来自两个公共医学数据集中乳腺癌、子宫内膜癌和肺癌队列中提取的特征来预测连续的HRD分数。广泛的实验证明，基于基础模型特征训练的模型在预测准确性和泛化能力方面始终优于基线模型，同时在不同的基础模型之间表现出系统性差异。此外，我们提出了一种基于分布的上采样策略来缓解这些数据集中的目标不平衡问题，显著改善了对代表性不足但具有临床重要性的患者群体的召回率和平衡准确率。此外，我们通过消融实验研究了不同采样策略和实例袋大小的影响。我们的结果强调了大规模组织病理学预训练对于更精确和可转移的回归生物标志物预测的益处，展示了其推动人工智能驱动的精准肿瘤学的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究了在组织病理学数据上预训练的基础模型（Foundation Models, FMs）对回归性生物标志物预测任务的影响，具体以预测同源重组缺陷（HRD）连续分数为例。研究在多实例学习（MIL）框架下，使用五种先进的FM提取特征，并与对比学习基线进行比较。实验结果表明，FM特征显著提高了预测模型的准确性和泛化能力。此外，作者提出了一种基于分布的上采样策略，有效解决了数据集中的目标不平衡问题，提升了对关键少数患者群体的预测性能。研究证实了大规模组织病理学预训练在推进精准肿瘤学中的巨大价值。
AI.keywords: 组织病理学基础模型, 同源重组缺陷, 回归预测, 多实例学习, 精准肿瘤学
AI.comments: 这项工作填补了组织病理学基础模型在回归预测任务应用上的研究空白。其创新点在于系统性地评估了多款SOTA基础模型在预测HRD连续分数这一临床重要生物标志物上的表现，并提出了有效的上采样策略来解决病理学数据中常见的标签分布不平衡问题。研究结果有力地证明了大规模预训练特征在提高预测准确性和模型泛化能力方面的优势，对于推动AI在精准肿瘤学中的实际应用具有重要意义。未来的研究可以探索如何优化不同基础模型特征的融合策略。

title: Joint Continual Learning of Local Language Models and Cloud Offloading Decisions with Budget Constraints
summary: Locally deployed Small Language Models (SLMs) must continually support diverse tasks under strict memory and computation constraints, making selective reliance on cloud Large Language Models (LLMs) unavoidable. Regulating cloud assistance during continual learning is challenging, as naive reward-based reinforcement learning often yields unstable offloading behavior and exacerbates catastrophic forgetting as task distributions shift. We propose DA-GRPO, a dual-advantage extension of Group Relative Policy Optimization that incorporates cloud-usage constraints directly into advantage computation, avoiding fixed reward shaping and external routing models. This design enables the local model to jointly learn task competence and collaboration behavior, allowing cloud requests to emerge naturally during post-training while respecting a prescribed assistance budget. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that DA-GRPO improves post-switch accuracy, substantially reduces forgetting, and maintains stable cloud usage compared to prior collaborative and routing-based approaches.

AI.title_translation: 具有预算约束的本地语言模型与云卸载决策的联合持续学习
AI.tldr: 本地部署的小型语言模型在持续学习中需要云端大型语言模型的协助，但管理卸载决策很困难。DA-GRPO提出一种方法，在预算约束下联合学习本地模型能力和云协作行为，提高了准确性并减少了遗忘。
AI.motivation: 本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）必须在严格的内存和计算约束下持续支持多样化任务，因此不可避免地需要选择性地依赖云端大型语言模型（LLM）。在持续学习中规范云协助具有挑战性，因为基于奖励的朴素强化学习常导致不稳定的卸载行为，并在任务分布变化时加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 提出DA-GRPO，这是Group Relative Policy Optimization的一种双优势扩展，它将云使用约束直接纳入优势计算中，避免了固定的奖励塑形和外部路由模型。这种设计使本地模型能够联合学习任务能力和协作行为，在训练后自然地产生云请求，同时遵守预设的协助预算。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，与先前的协作和基于路由的方法相比，DA-GRPO提高了切换后准确性，显著减少了遗忘，并保持了稳定的云使用。
AI.conclusion: DA-GRPO在预算约束下有效地解决了本地语言模型持续学习与云卸载决策的联合优化问题，提高了准确性，减少了遗忘，并保持了云使用的稳定性。
AI.translation: 本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）必须在严格的内存和计算约束下持续支持多样化任务，这使得选择性地依赖云端大型语言模型（LLM）变得不可避免。在持续学习过程中规范云协助具有挑战性，因为基于奖励的朴素强化学习往往导致不稳定的卸载行为，并在任务分布发生变化时加剧灾难性遗忘。我们提出了DA-GRPO，它是Group Relative Policy Optimization的一种双优势扩展，它将云使用约束直接纳入优势计算中，避免了固定的奖励塑形和外部路由模型。这种设计使本地模型能够联合学习任务能力和协作行为，从而在训练后自然地产生云请求，同时遵守预设的协助预算。在数学推理和代码生成基准上的实验表明，与先前的协作和基于路由的方法相比，DA-GRPO提高了切换后准确性，显著减少了遗忘，并保持了稳定的云使用。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决本地小型语言模型（SLM）在内存、计算和预算约束下，需要将任务卸载到云端大型语言模型（LLM）时，进行持续学习的挑战。传统的卸载强化学习方法常导致不稳定和灾难性遗忘。作者提出了DA-GRPO，作为Group Relative Policy Optimization的扩展，它将云使用约束直接整合到优势计算中。该方法使本地模型能够联合学习任务能力和协作行为，在遵守预算的同时自然地发出云请求。实验表明，DA-GRPO在数学推理和代码生成任务上提高了准确性，减少了遗忘，并稳定了云使用。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 小型语言模型, 云卸载, 预算约束, 强化学习
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新方法，将云卸载决策直接整合到本地SLM的持续学习过程中，超越了传统的奖励塑形或外部路由模型。通过将预算约束直接纳入优势计算，DA-GRPO提供了一种更稳定、更高效的云协助管理方式，这对于资源受限的边缘设备至关重要。联合学习任务能力和协作行为是一个显著的优势，有助于提高性能并减少遗忘。

title: DecompressionLM: Deterministic, Diagnostic, and Zero-Shot Concept Graph Extraction from Language Models
summary: Existing knowledge probing methods rely on pre-defined queries, limiting extraction to known concepts. We introduce DecompressionLM, a stateless framework for zero-shot concept graph extraction that discovers what language models encode without pre-specified queries or shared cross-sequence state. Our method targets three limitations of common decoding-based probing approaches: (i) cross-sequence coupling that concentrates probability mass on high-frequency prefixes, (ii) competitive decoding effects that suppress long-tail concepts, and (iii) scalability constraints arising from sequential exploration. Using Van der Corput low-discrepancy sequences with arithmetic decoding, DecompressionLM enables deterministic, embarrassingly parallel generation without shared state across sequences. Across two model families and five quantization variants, we find that activation-aware quantization (AWQ-4bit) expands concept coverage by 30-170%, while uniform quantization (GPTQ-Int4) induces 71-86% coverage collapse - divergent behaviors not reliably reflected by explanation-level perplexity. Corpus-based verification further reveals a 19.6-point hallucination gap between top- and bottom-ranked MMLU-Pro Law models. DecompressionLM establishes concept coverage as a complementary evaluation dimension for assessing knowledge breadth and factual grounding in compressed models intended for deployment.

AI.title_translation: DecompressionLM：确定性、诊断性和零样本的语言模型概念图谱提取
AI.tldr: DecompressionLM是一种新的无状态、并行框架，用于零样本地从语言模型中提取概念图谱。它解决了现有方法的局限性，并发现激活感知量化（AWQ）能显著扩大概念覆盖范围，而统一量化（GPTQ）会导致严重的概念覆盖崩溃。该方法为评估部署的压缩模型提供了新的诊断维度。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识探测方法依赖于预定义的查询，将提取限制在已知概念上。此外，常见的基于解码的探测方法存在三个局限性：（i）跨序列耦合，导致概率集中于高频前缀；（ii）竞争性解码效应，抑制长尾概念；（iii）顺序探索带来的可扩展性限制。
AI.method: 提出DecompressionLM框架，这是一个无状态的零样本概念图谱提取框架。该方法使用Van der Corput低差异序列配合算术解码，实现了确定性、极易并行化的生成，且序列之间无需共享状态。
AI.result: 在两种模型系列和五种量化变体上测试发现：激活感知量化（AWQ-4bit）将概念覆盖率扩大了30%至170%；而统一量化（GPTQ-Int4）导致覆盖率下降了71%至86%。这些差异行为无法通过解释级困惑度可靠反映。基于语料库的验证显示，排名最高和最低的MMLU-Pro法律模型之间存在19.6个百分点的“幻觉”差距。
AI.conclusion: DecompressionLM将概念覆盖率确立为一个互补的评估维度，用于评估旨在部署的压缩模型中的知识广度和事实基础。
AI.translation: 现有的知识探测方法依赖于预定义的查询，将提取限制在已知概念上。我们引入了DecompressionLM，这是一个用于零样本概念图谱提取的无状态框架，它无需预先指定的查询或共享的跨序列状态，即可发现语言模型编码了哪些内容。我们的方法旨在解决常见基于解码的探测方法的三大局限性：（i）跨序列耦合，将概率质量集中在高频前缀上；（ii）竞争性解码效应，抑制长尾概念；以及（iii）序列探索带来的可扩展性限制。DecompressionLM使用Van der Corput低差异序列与算术解码相结合，实现了确定性、极易并行化的生成，且序列之间无需共享状态。我们在两种模型系列和五种量化变体上进行测试发现，激活感知量化（AWQ-4bit）将概念覆盖率扩大了30%至170%，而统一量化（GPTQ-Int4）则导致了71%至86%的覆盖率崩溃——这些分歧行为无法通过解释级困惑度可靠反映。基于语料库的验证进一步揭示了在MMLU-Pro法律模型中，排名最高和最低的模型之间存在19.6个百分点的“幻觉”差距。DecompressionLM确立了概念覆盖率作为一个互补的评估维度，用于评估旨在部署的压缩模型中的知识广度和事实基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DecompressionLM，这是一个新颖的无状态、并行框架，用于零样本概念图谱提取。它解决了现有基于查询和顺序解码方法（如序列耦合和长尾概念抑制）的局限性。DecompressionLM利用Van der Corput序列和算术解码，实现了确定性和大规模并行生成。实验结果表明，激活感知量化（AWQ-4bit）显著扩大了概念覆盖范围（30%-170%），而统一量化（GPTQ-Int4）则导致了严重的覆盖率崩溃（71%-86%）。该框架成功将概念覆盖率确立为评估部署的压缩模型知识广度和事实基础的关键诊断维度。
AI.keywords: DecompressionLM, 概念图谱提取, 零样本, 量化, 概念覆盖率
AI.comments: 本文最大的创新在于提供了一种从基于查询的“已知”知识探测转向零样本“编码”知识发现的无状态、并行框架。通过使用Van der Corput低差异序列和算术解码，该方法巧妙地解决了现有解码方法的局限性（如竞争和耦合），实现了确定性、可扩展的知识提取。其重要性在于，DecompressionLM揭示了不同量化策略对模型内在知识广度的巨大影响（AWQ提升，GPTQ崩溃），并证明了传统的困惑度指标无法可靠反映这些行为。这为评估和部署压缩模型提供了一个至关重要的、互补的诊断维度，对于理解和减轻模型“幻觉”具有重要价值。

title: Robust automatic brain vessel segmentation in 3D CTA scans using dynamic 4D-CTA data
summary: In this study, we develop a novel methodology for annotating the brain vasculature using dynamic 4D-CTA head scans. By using multiple time points from dynamic CTA acquisitions, we subtract bone and soft tissue to enhance the visualization of arteries and veins, reducing the effort required to obtain manual annotations of brain vessels. We then train deep learning models on our ground truth annotations by using the same segmentation for multiple phases from the dynamic 4D-CTA collection, effectively enlarging our dataset by 4 to 5 times and inducing robustness to contrast phases. In total, our dataset comprises 110 training images from 25 patients and 165 test images from 14 patients. In comparison with two similarly-sized datasets for CTA-based brain vessel segmentation, a nnUNet model trained on our dataset can achieve significantly better segmentations across all vascular regions, with an average mDC of 0.846 for arteries and 0.957 for veins in the TopBrain dataset. Furthermore, metrics such as average directed Hausdorff distance (adHD) and topology sensitivity (tSens) reflected similar trends: using our dataset resulted in low error margins (adHD of 0.304 mm for arteries and 0.078 for veins) and high sensitivity (tSens of 0.877 for arteries and 0.974 for veins), indicating excellent accuracy in capturing vessel morphology. Our code and model weights are available online at https://github.com/alceballosa/robust-vessel-segmentation

title: ACE-Step 1.5: Pushing the Boundaries of Open-Source Music Generation
summary: We present ACE-Step v1.5, a highly efficient open-source music foundation model that brings commercial-grade generation to consumer hardware. On commonly used evaluation metrics, ACE-Step v1.5 achieves quality beyond most commercial music models while remaining extremely fast -- under 2 seconds per full song on an A100 and under 10 seconds on an RTX 3090. The model runs locally with less than 4GB of VRAM, and supports lightweight personalization: users can train a LoRA from just a few songs to capture their own style. At its core lies a novel hybrid architecture where the Language Model (LM) functions as an omni-capable planner: it transforms simple user queries into comprehensive song blueprints -- scaling from short loops to 10-minute compositions -- while synthesizing metadata, lyrics, and captions via Chain-of-Thought to guide the Diffusion Transformer (DiT). Uniquely, this alignment is achieved through intrinsic reinforcement learning relying solely on the model's internal mechanisms, thereby eliminating the biases inherent in external reward models or human preferences. Beyond standard synthesis, ACE-Step v1.5 unifies precise stylistic control with versatile editing capabilities -- such as cover generation, repainting, and vocal-to-BGM conversion -- while maintaining strict adherence to prompts across 50+ languages. This paves the way for powerful tools that seamlessly integrate into the creative workflows of music artists, producers, and content creators. The code, the model weights and the demo are available at: https://ace-step.github.io/ace-step-v1.5.github.io/

AI.title_translation: ACE-Step 1.5：推动开源音乐生成的界限
AI.tldr: ACE-Step v1.5是一个高效的开源音乐模型，它在消费级硬件上实现了商业级生成质量和极快的速度（RTX 3090上不到10秒），采用LM/DiT混合架构，通过内在强化学习对齐，并支持LoRA风格个性化和多功能编辑。
AI.motivation: 开发一个高效、开源的音乐基础模型，使商业级质量的音乐生成能够在消费级硬件上运行，并提供轻量级个性化和多功能编辑能力，以更好地服务音乐创作者和内容制作者。
AI.method: 采用新颖的混合架构：语言模型（LM）充当全能规划器，通过“思维链”（Chain-of-Thought）将用户查询转化为包含元数据和歌词的综合歌曲蓝图。这些蓝图随后用于指导扩散Transformer（DiT）进行合成。模型对齐通过内在强化学习实现，仅依赖于模型的内部机制，以消除外部奖励模型的偏差。
AI.result: 在常用评估指标上，生成质量超越大多数商业音乐模型。生成速度极快：A100上每首完整歌曲不到2秒，RTX 3090上不到10秒。模型可在本地运行，显存需求低于4GB。支持仅用少量歌曲训练LoRA进行轻量级风格个性化。统一了精确风格控制和多功能编辑能力（如翻唱、重绘），并能在50多种语言中严格遵循提示。
AI.conclusion: ACE-Step v1.5为强大的音乐创作和编辑工具铺平了道路，这些工具可以无缝集成到音乐艺术家、制作人和内容创作者的创意工作流程中。
AI.translation: 我们推出了ACE-Step v1.5，这是一个高效的开源音乐基础模型，它将商业级生成带到了消费级硬件上。在常用的评估指标上，ACE-Step v1.5的质量超越了大多数商业音乐模型，同时保持了极快的速度——在A100上每首完整歌曲不到2秒，在RTX 3090上不到10秒。该模型可以在本地运行，显存（VRAM）需求低于4GB，并支持轻量级个性化：用户只需用几首歌曲即可训练一个LoRA来捕捉自己的风格。其核心在于一种新颖的混合架构，其中语言模型（LM）充当全能规划器：它将简单的用户查询转化为综合的歌曲蓝图——可从短循环扩展到10分钟的创作——同时通过思维链（Chain-of-Thought）合成元数据、歌词和字幕来指导扩散Transformer（DiT）。独特的是，这种对齐是通过内在强化学习实现的，仅依赖于模型的内部机制，从而消除了外部奖励模型或人类偏见所固有的偏差。除了标准的合成之外，ACE-Step v1.5将精确的风格控制与多功能编辑能力（如翻唱生成、重绘和人声转背景音乐转换）相结合，同时在50多种语言中保持对提示的严格遵循。这为强大的工具铺平了道路，这些工具可以无缝集成到音乐艺术家、制作人和内容创作者的创意工作流程中。代码、模型权重和演示版本可在：https://ace-step.github.io/ace-step-v1.5.github.io/ 获取。
AI.summary: ACE-Step v1.5是一个高效的开源音乐基础模型，它在消费级硬件上实现了商业级生成质量和极快的速度。该模型采用LM作为规划器、DiT作为合成器的新颖混合架构，并通过内在强化学习进行对齐。它支持轻量级风格个性化，并集成了精确风格控制与多功能编辑能力，旨在为音乐创作者提供无缝集成的强大工具。
AI.keywords: 开源音乐生成, 混合架构, 内在强化学习, 消费级硬件, LoRA个性化
AI.comments: ACE-Step v1.5的创新之处在于其新颖的混合架构，其中语言模型（LM）充当高层规划器，负责生成复杂的歌曲蓝图、元数据和歌词，而扩散Transformer（DiT）负责实际的音频合成。更关键的是，它利用内在强化学习（intrinsic reinforcement learning）进行模型对齐，有效地绕开了依赖外部奖励模型或人类反馈所带来的偏见和成本。其重要性在于，该模型在保持超越多数商业模型的生成质量的同时，极大地优化了效率和硬件要求，使其能够在消费级硬件上（如RTX 3090）快速运行，并且VRAM需求低于4GB，这极大地降低了高质量音乐生成技术的门槛，促进了开源社区的发展。此外，对轻量级个性化（LoRA）和多功能编辑能力的支持，使其能够无缝集成到专业创意工作流程中。

title: Invariance on Manifolds: Understanding Robust Visual Representations for Place Recognition
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) demands representations robust to drastic environmental and viewpoint shifts. Current aggregation paradigms, however, either rely on data-hungry supervision or simplistic first-order statistics, often neglecting intrinsic structural correlations. In this work, we propose a Second-Order Geometric Statistics framework that inherently captures geometric stability without training. We conceptualize scenes as covariance descriptors on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold, where perturbations manifest as tractable congruence transformations. By leveraging geometry-aware Riemannian mappings, we project these descriptors into a linearized Euclidean embedding, effectively decoupling signal structure from noise. Our approach introduces a training-free framework built upon fixed, pre-trained backbones, achieving strong zero-shot generalization without parameter updates. Extensive experiments confirm that our method achieves highly competitive performance against state-of-the-art baselines, particularly excelling in challenging zero-shot scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 流形上的不变性：理解用于地点识别的鲁棒视觉表示
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的二阶几何统计框架，通过将场景表示为SPD流形上的协方差描述符，并利用黎曼映射将其线性化，从而实现对地点识别鲁棒的零样本泛化表示。
AI.motivation: 视觉地点识别（VPR）要求表示形式对剧烈的环境和视点变化具有鲁棒性。然而，当前的聚合范式要么依赖数据密集型监督，要么依赖简单的一阶统计量，常常忽略内在的结构相关性。
AI.method: 提出一个二阶几何统计框架，无需训练。将场景概念化为对称正定（SPD）流形上的协方差描述符，将扰动视为可处理的同余变换。利用几何感知的黎曼映射，将这些描述符投影到线性化的欧几里得嵌入空间中，有效解耦信号结构和噪声。该框架建立在固定的、预训练的主干网络之上。
AI.result: 实验证实，该方法在性能上与最先进的基线方法具有高度竞争力，尤其在具有挑战性的零样本场景中表现出色。
AI.translation: 视觉地点识别（VPR）要求表示形式对剧烈的环境和视点变化具有鲁棒性。然而，当前的聚合范式要么依赖数据密集型监督，要么依赖简单的一阶统计量，常常忽略内在的结构相关性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个二阶几何统计框架，该框架无需训练即可固有地捕获几何稳定性。我们将场景概念化为对称正定（SPD）流形上的协方差描述符，其中扰动表现为可处理的同余变换。通过利用几何感知的黎曼映射，我们将这些描述符投影到线性化的欧几里得嵌入空间中，从而有效地将信号结构与噪声解耦。我们的方法引入了一个基于固定、预训练主干网络的无需训练框架，无需参数更新即可实现强大的零样本泛化。广泛的实验证实，我们的方法与最先进的基线方法相比取得了高度竞争性的性能，特别是在具有挑战性的零样本场景中表现出色。
AI.summary: 针对视觉地点识别（VPR）中现有方法鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出了一个无需训练的二阶几何统计框架。该框架将场景表示为对称正定（SPD）流形上的协方差描述符，并利用黎曼映射将其投影到欧几里得空间以实现结构与噪声的解耦。该方法在固定的预训练主干网络上运行，实现了强大的零样本泛化能力，并在实验中表现出与现有最佳方法相当的竞争力。
AI.keywords: 视觉地点识别, 二阶几何统计, SPD流形, 零样本泛化, 黎曼映射
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将二阶几何统计学引入视觉地点识别（VPR），并利用SPD流形的几何特性来处理视觉表示中的不变性问题。通过将场景建模为协方差描述符并在黎曼空间中进行线性化嵌入，它提供了一种优雅且无需训练的方法来解耦信号结构和环境噪声。其重要性在于提供了一种强大的、无需数据饥饿型监督的零样本泛化能力，这对于实际部署和泛化到新环境至关重要。局限性（未在摘要中明确提及，但可推测）可能在于计算协方差矩阵和进行黎曼映射的计算效率，以及对预训练主干网络特征质量的依赖性。

title: Hallucination is a Consequence of Space-Optimality: A Rate-Distortion Theorem for Membership Testing
summary: Large language models often hallucinate with high confidence on "random facts" that lack inferable patterns. We formalize the memorization of such facts as a membership testing problem, unifying the discrete error metrics of Bloom filters with the continuous log-loss of LLMs. By analyzing this problem in the regime where facts are sparse in the universe of plausible claims, we establish a rate-distortion theorem: the optimal memory efficiency is characterized by the minimum KL divergence between score distributions on facts and non-facts. This theoretical framework provides a distinctive explanation for hallucination: even with optimal training, perfect data, and a simplified "closed world" setting, the information-theoretically optimal strategy under limited capacity is not to abstain or forget, but to assign high confidence to some non-facts, resulting in hallucination. We validate this theory empirically on synthetic data, showing that hallucinations persist as a natural consequence of lossy compression.

AI.title_translation: 幻觉是空间最优性的结果：一个用于成员测试的率失真定理
AI.tldr: 理论证明，大型语言模型中的幻觉并非训练缺陷，而是在有限容量下追求最优内存效率（空间最优性）的信息论必然结果，等同于有损压缩。
AI.motivation: 描述大型语言模型（LLMs）为何会以高置信度对缺乏可推断模式的“随机事实”产生幻觉。作者将这种事实的记忆形式化为一个可供理论分析的问题。
AI.method: 将事实的记忆形式化为成员测试问题，统一了布隆过滤器（Bloom filters）的离散错误度量和LLM的连续对数损失（log-loss）。在事实在所有可能声明中稀疏的假设下，建立了一个率失真定理。
AI.result: 建立了率失真定理：最优内存效率由事实和非事实得分分布之间的最小KL散度来表征。经验上，通过合成数据验证了该理论，表明幻觉是信息有损压缩的自然结果。
AI.conclusion: 即使在最优训练、完美数据和简化的“封闭世界”设置下，在有限容量下，信息论上最优的策略不是放弃或遗忘，而是对某些非事实赋予高置信度，从而导致幻觉。幻觉是空间最优性（有限容量下的最优策略）的必然结果。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）经常对缺乏可推断模式的“随机事实”以高置信度产生幻觉。我们将此类事实的记忆形式化为一个成员测试问题，统一了布隆过滤器的离散错误度量和LLMs的连续对数损失。通过分析事实在所有可能声明中稀疏的机制，我们建立了一个率失真定理：最优内存效率由事实和非事实得分分布之间的最小KL散度来表征。这一理论框架为幻觉提供了一个独特的解释：即使在最优训练、完美数据和简化的“封闭世界”设置下，有限容量下的信息论最优策略不是放弃或遗忘，而是对某些非事实赋予高置信度，从而导致幻觉。我们通过合成数据经验验证了这一理论，表明幻觉作为有损压缩的自然结果持续存在。
AI.summary: 本文将LLM对“随机事实”的记忆形式化为成员测试问题，并建立了一个率失真定理。该定理表明，最优内存效率由事实和非事实得分分布之间的最小KL散度决定。基于此理论，作者提出幻觉是空间最优性（有限容量）的必然结果：在信息论最优策略下，模型必须对某些非事实赋予高置信度，这本质上是一种有损压缩。合成数据实验验证了这一结论。
AI.keywords: 幻觉, 率失真定理, 成员测试, 空间最优性, KL散度
AI.comments: 这项工作提供了一个信息论基础来理解LLM幻觉的根本原因，将其从模型训练或数据缺陷问题提升到了一个理论最优性问题。其创新点在于将成员测试问题、布隆过滤器和LLM的连续对数损失统一在一个率失真框架内。核心洞察是：幻觉并非模型失败，而是有限资源下实现信息最优压缩的必要代价（空间最优性）。这对于未来设计更高效或更可靠的LLM架构具有重要指导意义。

title: Unifying Ranking and Generation in Query Auto-Completion via Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Multi-Objective Alignment
summary: Query Auto-Completion (QAC) suggests query completions as users type, helping them articulate intent and reach results more efficiently. Existing approaches face fundamental challenges: traditional retrieve-and-rank pipelines have limited long-tail coverage and require extensive feature engineering, while recent generative methods suffer from hallucination and safety risks. We present a unified framework that reformulates QAC as end-to-end list generation through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and multi-objective Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Our approach combines three key innovations: (1) reformulating QAC as end-to-end list generation with multi-objective optimization; (2) defining and deploying a suite of rule-based, model-based, and LLM-as-judge verifiers for QAC, and using them in a comprehensive methodology that combines RAG, multi-objective DPO, and iterative critique-revision for high-quality synthetic data; (3) a hybrid serving architecture enabling efficient production deployment under strict latency constraints. Evaluation on a large-scale commercial search platform demonstrates substantial improvements: offline metrics show gains across all dimensions, human evaluation yields +0.40 to +0.69 preference scores, and a controlled online experiment achieves 5.44\% reduction in keystrokes and 3.46\% increase in suggestion adoption, validating that unified generation with RAG and multi-objective alignment provides an effective solution for production QAC. This work represents a paradigm shift to end-to-end generation powered by large language models, RAG, and multi-objective alignment, establishing a production-validated framework that can benefit the broader search and recommendation industry.

AI.title_translation: 通过检索增强生成和多目标对齐统一查询自动补全中的排序和生成
AI.tldr: 一种新的统一 RAG/DPO 框架将查询自动补全（QAC）重构为列表生成，解决了传统方法的长尾覆盖和生成方法的幻觉问题。该框架在生产环境中表现出色，实现了大幅改进（偏好得分+0.40，击键次数减少5.44\%）。
AI.motivation: 现有查询自动补全（QAC）方法面临挑战：传统的检索-排序流程覆盖长尾有限且需要大量特征工程；近期的生成式方法存在幻觉和安全风险。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）和多目标直接偏好优化（DPO），将QAC重构为端到端列表生成。关键创新包括：使用多目标优化；定义并部署了一套基于规则、模型和LLM-as-judge的验证器，用于结合RAG、多目标DPO和迭代批判-修正方法来生成高质量的合成数据；采用了混合服务架构以实现高效的生产部署。
AI.result: 在大型商业搜索平台上，离线指标在所有维度上均有所提升。人工评估偏好得分提高了+0.40至+0.69。受控在线实验实现了击键次数减少5.44\%，建议采纳率增加3.46\%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的生成方法，结合检索增强生成（RAG）和多目标对齐，为生产环境下的查询自动补全（QAC）提供了一个有效的解决方案，代表了由大型语言模型、RAG和多目标对齐驱动的端到端生成范式的转变，建立了一个经过生产验证的框架。
AI.translation: 查询自动补全（QAC）在用户输入时提供查询建议，帮助他们更有效地表达意图并获得结果。现有方法面临根本性挑战：传统的检索-排序流程长尾覆盖有限，且需要大量的特征工程；而近期的生成式方法则存在幻觉和安全风险。我们提出了一个统一的框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）和多目标直接偏好优化（DPO），将QAC重构为端到端列表生成。我们的方法结合了三个关键创新点：(1) 将QAC重构为具有多目标优化的端到端列表生成；(2) 定义和部署了一套基于规则、基于模型和以LLM为评判者的验证器用于QAC，并将其用于结合RAG、多目标DPO和迭代批判-修正的综合方法中，以生成高质量的合成数据；(3) 一种混合服务架构，能够在严格的延迟限制下实现高效的生产部署。在大型商业搜索平台上的评估显示出显著的改进：离线指标在所有维度上均有所提升，人工评估偏好得分提高了+0.40至+0.69，受控在线实验实现了击键次数减少5.44\%，建议采纳率增加3.46\%，验证了结合RAG和多目标对齐的统一生成方法为生产QAC提供了一个有效的解决方案。这项工作代表了由大型语言模型、RAG和多目标对齐驱动的端到端生成的范式转变，建立了一个经过生产验证的框架，可以惠及更广泛的搜索和推荐行业。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个统一框架，通过检索增强生成（RAG）和多目标直接偏好优化（DPO），将查询自动补全（QAC）重构为端到端列表生成任务，解决了传统方法的长尾覆盖不足和生成方法的幻觉问题。该框架结合了多目标优化、一套验证器和混合服务架构，并在大规模商业搜索平台上取得了显著成果，包括离线指标的全面提升和在线实验中击键次数及建议采纳率的显著改善。
AI.keywords: 查询自动补全, 检索增强生成, 多目标对齐, 列表生成, DPO
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于通过RAG和多目标DPO实现了排序和生成的统一，将QAC范式转向了端到端的生成。这种方法有效地解决了传统QAC方法的长尾覆盖限制和纯生成方法的幻觉及安全风险。利用多目标DPO和一套全面的验证器（包括LLM-as-judge）来生成高质量合成数据，是解决生成模型质量控制问题的关键。该框架经过大规模商业平台的生产验证，在离线和在线指标上均取得了显著提升（例如击键次数减少5.44\%），这证明了其在实际应用中的高效性和重要性，有望推动搜索和推荐领域的技术进步。

title: GMAC: Global Multi-View Constraint for Automatic Multi-Camera Extrinsic Calibration
comments: A 5-page paper with 1 figure, prepared for submission to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
summary: Automatic calibration of multi-camera systems, namely the accurate estimation of spatial extrinsic parameters, is fundamental for 3D reconstruction, panoramic perception, and multi-view data fusion. Existing methods typically rely on calibration targets, explicit geometric modeling, or task-specific neural networks. Such approaches often exhibit limited robustness and applicability in complex dynamic environments or online scenarios, making them difficult to deploy in practical applications. To address this, this paper proposes GMAC, a multi-camera extrinsic estimation framework based on the implicit geometric representations learned by multi-view reconstruction networks. GMAC models extrinsics as global variables constrained by the latent multi-view geometric structure and prunes and structurally reconfigures existing networks so that their latent features can directly support extrinsic prediction through a lightweight regression head, without requiring a completely new network design. Furthermore, GMAC jointly optimizes cross-view reprojection consistency and multi-view cycle consistency, ensuring geometric coherence across cameras while improving prediction accuracy and optimization stability. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world multi-camera datasets demonstrate that GMAC achieves accurate and stable extrinsic estimation without explicit 3D reconstruction or manual calibration, providing a new solution for efficient deployment and online calibration of multi-camera systems.

title: FUSE-Flow: Scalable Real-Time Multi-View Point Cloud Reconstruction Using Confidence
comments: A 5-page paper, prepared for submission to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
summary: Real-time multi-view point cloud reconstruction is a core problem in 3D vision and immersive perception, with wide applications in VR, AR, robotic navigation, digital twins, and computer interaction. Despite advances in multi-camera systems and high-resolution depth sensors, fusing large-scale multi-view depth observations into high-quality point clouds under strict real-time constraints remains challenging. Existing methods relying on voxel-based fusion, temporal accumulation, or global optimization suffer from high computational complexity, excessive memory usage, and limited scalability, failing to simultaneously achieve real-time performance, reconstruction quality, and multi-camera extensibility. We propose FUSE-Flow, a frame-wise, stateless, and linearly scalable point cloud streaming reconstruction framework. Each frame independently generates point cloud fragments, fused via two weights, measurement confidence and 3D distance consistency to suppress noise while preserving geometric details. For large-scale multi-camera efficiency, we introduce an adaptive spatial hashing-based weighted aggregation method: 3D space is adaptively partitioned by local point cloud density, representative points are selected per cell, and weighted fusion is performed to handle both sparse and dense regions. With GPU parallelization, FUSE-Flow achieves high-throughput, low-latency point cloud generation and fusion with linear complexity. Experiments demonstrate that the framework improves reconstruction stability and geometric fidelity in overlapping, depth-discontinuous, and dynamic scenes, while maintaining real-time frame rates on modern GPUs, verifying its effectiveness, robustness, and scalability.

title: Bifrost: A Much Simpler Secure Two-Party Data Join Protocol for Secure Data Analytics
summary:
Secure data join enables two parties with vertically distributed data to securely compute the joined table, allowing the parties to perform downstream Secure multi-party computation-based Data Analytics (SDA), such as training machine learning models, based on the joined table. While Circuit-based Private Set Intersection (CPSI) can be used for secure data join, it introduces redundant dummy rows in the joined table, which results in high overhead in the downstream SDA tasks. iPrivJoin addresses this issue but introduces significant communication overhead in the redundancy removal process, as it relies on the cryptographic primitive OPPRF for data encoding and multiple rounds of oblivious shuffles.
  In this paper, we propose a much simpler secure data join protocol, Bifrost, which outputs (the secret shares of) a redundancy-free joined table. The highlight of Bifrost lies in its simplicity: it builds upon two conceptually simple building blocks, an ECDH-PSI protocol and a two-party oblivious shuffle protocol. The lightweight protocol design allows Bifrost to avoid the need for OPPRF. We also proposed a simple optimization named \textit{dual mapping} that reduces the rounds of oblivious shuffle needed from two to one. Experiments on datasets of up to 100 GB show that Bifrost achieves $2.54 \sim 22.32\times$ speedup and reduces the communication by $84.15\% \sim 88.97\%$ compared to the SOTA redundancy-free secure data join protocol iPrivJoin. Notably, the communication size of Bifrost is nearly equal to the size of the input data. In the two-step SDA pipeline evaluation (secure join and SDA), the redundancy-free property of Bifrost not only avoids the catastrophic error rate blowup in the downstream tasks caused by the dummy rows in the joined table (as introduced in CPSI), but also shows up to $2.80\times$ speed-up in the SDA process with up to $73.15\%$ communication reduction.

title: TxRay: Agentic Postmortem of Live Blockchain Attacks
summary:
Decentralized Finance (DeFi) has turned blockchains into financial infrastructure, allowing anyone to trade, lend, and build protocols without intermediaries, but this openness exposes pools of value controlled by code. Within five years, the DeFi ecosystem has lost over 15.75B USD to reported exploits. Many exploits arise from permissionless opportunities that any participant can trigger using only public state and standard interfaces, which we call Anyone-Can-Take (ACT) opportunities. Despite on-chain transparency, postmortem analysis remains slow and manual: investigations start from limited evidence, sometimes only a single transaction hash, and must reconstruct the exploit lifecycle by recovering related transactions, contract code, and state dependencies.
  We present TxRay, a Large Language Model (LLM) agentic postmortem system that uses tool calls to reconstruct live ACT attacks from limited evidence. Starting from one or more seed transactions, TxRay recovers the exploit lifecycle, derives an evidence-backed root cause, and generates a runnable, self-contained Proof of Concept (PoC) that deterministically reproduces the incident. TxRay self-checks postmortems by encoding incident-specific semantic oracles as executable assertions.
  To evaluate PoC correctness and quality, we develop PoCEvaluator, an independent agentic execution-and-review evaluator. On 114 incidents from DeFiHackLabs, TxRay produces an expert-aligned root cause and an executable PoC for 105 incidents, achieving 92.11% end-to-end reproduction. Under PoCEvaluator, 98.1% of TxRay PoCs avoid hard-coding attacker addresses, a +22.9pp lift over DeFiHackLabs. In a live deployment, TxRay delivers validated root causes in 40 minutes and PoCs in 59 minutes at median latency. TxRay's oracle-validated PoCs enable attack imitation, improving coverage by 15.6% and 65.5% over STING and APE.

title: The Enhanced Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: Applications of Newton's Laws in Financial Deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) Algorithms
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), a subset of machine learning focused on sequential decision-making, has emerged as a powerful approach for tackling financial trading problems. In finance, DRL is commonly used either to generate discrete trade signals or to determine continuous portfolio allocations. In this work, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework for portfolio optimization that incorporates Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (PIKANs) into several DRL algorithms. The approach replaces conventional multilayer perceptrons with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) in both actor and critic components-utilizing learnable B-spline univariate functions to achieve parameter-efficient and more interpretable function approximation. During actor updates, we introduce a physics-informed regularization loss that promotes second-order temporal consistency between observed return dynamics and the action-induced portfolio adjustments. The proposed framework is evaluated across three equity markets-China, Vietnam, and the United States, covering both emerging and developed economies. Across all three markets, PIKAN-based agents consistently deliver higher cumulative and annualized returns, superior Sharpe and Calmar ratios, and more favorable drawdown characteristics compared to both standard DRL baselines and classical online portfolio-selection methods. This yields more stable training, higher Sharpe ratios, and superior performance compared to traditional DRL counterparts. The approach is particularly valuable in highly dynamic and noisy financial markets, where conventional DRL often suffers from instability and poor generalization.

title: The Gradient-Causal Gap: Why Gradient Importance Fails on Complex Tasks
summary: Removing ''important'' high-gradient components from a neural network can improve generalization, while removing unimportant'' low-gradient components can destroy it. We demonstrate this paradox by formalizing the \textit{Gradient-Causal Gap} in Transformers trained on algorithmic tasks. While gradient magnitude and causal importance align on simple tasks ($ρ=0.73$ for reversal), this relationship collapses as task complexity increases ($ρ=0.32$ for sorting), sometimes becoming inverted ($ρ=-0.11$). Pruning experiments reveal that gradient magnitude is not merely inaccurate but \textit{unpredictably} so. Removing low-gradient ''Hidden Heroes'' consistently devastates OOD accuracy ($-32\%$). Removing high-gradient ''Gradient Bloats'' is a coin flip: harmless in most seeds (indicating optimization noise), catastrophic in others (indicating overfitting circuits). This unpredictability means gradient-based pruning cannot reliably preserve model capabilities.

title: Governance at the Edge of Architecture: Regulating NeuroAI and Neuromorphic Systems
summary: Current AI governance frameworks, including regulatory benchmarks for accuracy, latency, and energy efficiency, are built for static, centrally trained artificial neural networks on von Neumann hardware. NeuroAI systems, embodied in neuromorphic hardware and implemented via spiking neural networks, break these assumptions. This paper examines the limitations of current AI governance frameworks for NeuroAI, arguing that assurance and audit methods must co-evolve with these architectures, aligning traditional regulatory metrics with the physics, learning dynamics, and embodied efficiency of brain-inspired computation to enable technically grounded assurance.

title: RFS: Reinforcement Learning with Residual Flow Steering for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Imitation learning has emerged as an effective approach for bootstrapping sequential decision-making in robotics, achieving strong performance even in high-dimensional dexterous manipulation tasks. Recent behavior cloning methods further leverage expressive generative models, such as diffusion models and flow matching, to represent multimodal action distributions. However, policies pretrained in this manner often exhibit limited generalization and require additional fine-tuning to achieve robust performance at deployment time. Such adaptation must preserve the global exploration benefits of pretraining while enabling rapid correction of local execution errors. We propose Residual Flow Steering(RFS), a data-efficient reinforcement learning framework for adapting pretrained generative policies. RFS steers a pretrained flow-matching policy by jointly optimizing a residual action and a latent noise distribution, enabling complementary forms of exploration: local refinement through residual corrections and global exploration through latent-space modulation. This design allows efficient adaptation while retaining the expressive structure of the pretrained policy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of RFS on dexterous manipulation tasks, showing efficient fine-tuning in both simulation and real-world settings when adapting pretrained base policies. Project website:https://weirdlabuw.github.io/rfs.

title: Performance Guarantees of Cellular Networks with Hardcore Regulation and Scheduling
summary: Providing performance guarantees is one of the critical objectives of recent and future communication networks, toward which regulations, i.e., constraints on key system parameters, have played an indispensable role. This is the case for large wireless communication networks, where spatial regulations (e.g., constraints on intercell distance) have recently been shown, through a spatial network calculus, to be essential for establishing provable wireless link-level guarantees. In this work, we focus on performance guarantees for the downlink of cellular networks where we impose a hardcore (spatial) regulation on base station (BS) locations and evaluate how BS scheduling (which controls which BSs can transmit at a given time) impacts performance. Hardcore regulation is the simplest form of spatial regulation that enforces a minimal distance between any pair of transmitters in the network. Within this framework of spatial network calculus, we first provide an upper bound on the power of total interference for a spatially regulated cellular network, and then, identify the regimes where scheduling BSs yields better link-level rate guarantees compared to scenarios where base stations are always active. The hexagonal cellular network is analyzed as a special case. The results offer insights into what spatial regulations are needed, when to choose scheduling, and how to potentially reduce the network power consumption to provide a certain target performance guarantee.

AI.title_translation: 具有硬核调控和调度的蜂窝网络的性能保证
AI.tldr: 本文使用空间网络演算，研究了在基站位置施加硬核空间调控（最小间距）并结合基站调度，如何影响蜂窝网络下行链路的干扰上限和链路级速率保证。
AI.motivation: 为未来通信网络提供性能保证是关键目标之一，而调控（如空间约束）在其中起着不可或缺的作用。本文旨在评估在蜂窝网络下行链路中，施加硬核空间调控以及基站调度如何影响性能保证。
AI.method: 采用空间网络演算的框架。在基站位置施加硬核空间调控（最小距离），并评估基站调度（控制哪些基站可以传输）对性能的影响。首先提供总干扰功率的上限，然后识别调度能提供更好链路级速率保证的场景。还分析了六边形蜂窝网络作为特例。
AI.result: 1. 提供了空间调控蜂窝网络总干扰功率的上限。2. 识别了相比于基站始终活跃的场景，调度基站能够产生更好链路级速率保证的区域。3. 提供了关于所需空间调控、何时选择调度以及如何减少网络功耗以实现目标性能保证的见解。
AI.conclusion: 结果为确定所需的空间调控、选择调度的时机以及如何潜在地减少网络功耗以提供特定的目标性能保证，提供了深入的见解。
AI.translation: 提供性能保证是当前和未来通信网络的关键目标之一，为此，调控（即对关键系统参数的约束）发挥了不可或缺的作用。对于大型无线通信网络也是如此，最近通过空间网络演算表明，空间调控（例如，对小区间距离的约束）对于建立可证明的无线链路级保证至关重要。在这项工作中，我们关注蜂窝网络下行链路的性能保证，我们对基站（BS）位置施加硬核（空间）调控，并评估基站调度（控制在给定时间哪些基站可以传输）如何影响性能。硬核调控是空间调控最简单的形式，它强制网络中任意一对发射器之间存在最小距离。在这个空间网络演算的框架内，我们首先为空间调控的蜂窝网络提供了总干扰功率的上限，然后，确定了与基站始终处于活跃状态的场景相比，调度基站能够产生更好链路级速率保证的区域。六边形蜂窝网络被作为特例进行分析。这些结果为确定需要何种空间调控、何时选择调度以及如何潜在地减少网络功耗以提供特定的目标性能保证提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文利用空间网络演算框架，研究了在基站位置施加硬核空间调控（最小距离约束）的蜂窝网络下行链路的性能保证问题。研究评估了基站调度（控制发射）对性能的影响，并推导了网络总干扰功率的上限。研究识别了相比于基站始终活跃，调度能够提供更优链路级速率保证的场景，并以六边形网络为例进行了分析，为空间调控和调度策略的选择提供了指导。
AI.keywords: 性能保证, 蜂窝网络, 硬核调控, 空间网络演算, 基站调度
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将“空间网络演算”的理论框架应用于具有硬核空间调控（最小间距约束）的蜂窝网络，从而能够建立可证明的、非统计性的无线链路级性能保证。这种方法的重要性在于它将物理层（空间布局）的约束与网络层的性能保证联系起来，并提供了关于何时使用调度策略以优化速率保证和降低网络功耗的实用见解，对于设计高可靠性的未来通信网络具有指导意义。

title: From Latent Signals to Reflection Behavior: Tracing Meta-Cognitive Activation Trajectory in R1-Style LLMs
summary: R1-style LLMs have attracted growing attention for their capacity for self-reflection, yet the internal mechanisms underlying such behavior remain unclear. To bridge this gap, we anchor on the onset of reflection behavior and trace its layer-wise activation trajectory. Using the logit lens to read out token-level semantics, we uncover a structured progression: (i) Latent-control layers, where an approximate linear direction encodes the semantics of thinking budget; (ii) Semantic-pivot layers, where discourse-level cues, including turning-point and summarization cues, surface and dominate the probability mass; and (iii) Behavior-overt layers, where the likelihood of reflection-behavior tokens begins to rise until they become highly likely to be sampled. Moreover, our targeted interventions uncover a causal chain across these stages: prompt-level semantics modulate the projection of activations along latent-control directions, thereby inducing competition between turning-point and summarization cues in semantic-pivot layers, which in turn regulates the sampling likelihood of reflection-behavior tokens in behavior-overt layers. Collectively, our findings suggest a human-like meta-cognitive process-progressing from latent monitoring, to discourse-level regulation, and to finally overt self-reflection. Our analysis code can be found at https://github.com/DYR1/S3-CoT.

AI.title_translation: 从潜在信号到反思行为：追踪R1型大型语言模型中的元认知激活轨迹
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用对数几率透镜（logit lens）追踪了R1型LLMs中自我反思行为的层级激活轨迹，发现了从潜在控制、语义枢轴到行为外显的三个阶段的结构化过程，揭示了类似人类的元认知机制。
AI.motivation: 尽管R1型大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出自我反思能力，但其行为背后的内部机制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 以反思行为的发生为锚点，使用对数几率透镜（logit lens）读取标记级语义，追踪其逐层激活轨迹。并进行了有针对性的干预以探究因果链。
AI.result: 发现了一个结构化的三阶段进程：(i) 潜在控制层（编码思考预算语义）；(ii) 语义枢轴层（转向点和总结线索浮现并占据主导）；(iii) 行为外显层（反思行为标记的采样可能性开始上升）。干预证实了跨阶段的因果链：提示语义调节潜在控制方向的激活，进而诱导语义枢轴层中线索的竞争，最终调节反思行为标记的采样可能性。
AI.conclusion: 这一发现表明了一个类似人类的元认知过程，即从潜在监控到话语级调节，最终到外显的自我反思。
AI.translation: R1型大型语言模型（LLMs）因其自我反思能力而受到越来越多的关注，但这种行为背后的内部机制仍不清楚。为了弥补这一空白，我们以反思行为的发生为锚点，追踪其逐层激活轨迹。利用对数几率透镜（logit lens）读取标记级语义，我们揭示了一个结构化的进程：(i) 潜在控制层，其中近似的线性方向编码了思考预算的语义；(ii) 语义枢轴层，其中话语级线索，包括转向点和总结线索，浮现并主导了概率质量；(iii) 行为外显层，其中反思行为标记的可能性开始上升，直到它们变得极有可能被采样。此外，我们有针对性的干预揭示了跨越这些阶段的因果链：提示级别的语义调节沿着潜在控制方向的激活投影，从而诱导语义枢轴层中转向点和总结线索之间的竞争，这反过来又调节了行为外显层中反思行为标记的采样可能性。总的来说，我们的发现暗示了一个类似人类的元认知过程——从潜在监控，到话语级调节，最终到外显的自我反思。
AI.summary: 本文旨在揭示R1型LLMs自我反思行为的内部机制。通过使用对数几率透镜追踪层级激活轨迹，研究发现了一个由潜在控制、语义枢轴和行为外显组成的结构化三阶段进程。进一步的干预实验确定了从提示语义到激活投影再到反思标记采样的因果链。这些结果共同表明LLMs中的反思行为遵循类似于人类的元认知轨迹。
AI.keywords: R1型LLMs, 自我反思, 元认知激活轨迹, 对数几率透镜, 思考预算
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次系统地追踪了R1型LLMs中自我反思行为的内部激活轨迹，并将其分解为明确的三个阶段，从而将抽象的“自我反思”行为与模型内部具体的神经层级活动联系起来。通过引入“思考预算”（thinking budget）的语义编码和“转向点/总结线索”的竞争机制，为理解LLMs的元认知过程提供了具体的、可解释的框架。这对于未来设计更可靠、更具可解释性的高级推理和反思型LLMs具有重要的指导意义。

title: Scale-covariant spiking wavelets
summary: We establish a theoretical connection between wavelet transforms and spiking neural networks through scale-space theory. We rely on the scale-covariant guarantees in the leaky integrate-and-fire neurons to implement discrete mother wavelets that approximate continuous wavelets. A reconstruction experiment demonstrates the feasibility of the approach and warrants further analysis to mitigate current approximation errors. Our work suggests a novel spiking signal representation that could enable more energy-efficient signal processing algorithms.

AI.tldr: 通过尺度空间理论，建立了小波变换与脉冲神经网络的理论联系。利用LIF神经元的尺度协变性实现离散小波，实验证明了其可行性，有望实现更节能的信号处理。
AI.motivation: 建立一种新颖的脉冲信号表示方法，以期实现更节能的信号处理算法。
AI.method: 通过尺度空间理论，将小波变换与脉冲神经网络（SNNs）联系起来。具体方法是利用漏积分-发射（LIF）神经元的尺度协变保证来实现近似连续小波的离散母小波。
AI.result: 重建实验证明了该方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种新颖的、具有可行性的脉冲信号表示方法，但需要进一步分析以减轻当前的近似误差，有望实现更节能的信号处理算法。
AI.translation: 我们通过尺度空间理论，建立了小波变换与脉冲神经网络之间的理论联系。我们依靠漏积分-发射神经元中的尺度协变保证来实现近似连续小波的离散母小波。重建实验证明了该方法的可行性，并表明需要进一步分析以减轻当前的近似误差。我们的工作提出了一种新颖的脉冲信号表示，可以实现更节能的信号处理算法。
AI.summary: 本文基于尺度空间理论，首次建立了小波变换与脉冲神经网络（SNNs）的理论连接。研究人员利用漏积分-发射（LIF）神经元的尺度协变特性来实施离散母小波，以近似连续小波。重建实验验证了该方法的可行性，预示着一种可用于开发更节能信号处理算法的新型脉冲信号表示方法。
AI.keywords: 小波变换, 脉冲神经网络, 尺度协变, 信号处理, 漏积分-发射神经元
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将传统的小波分析（一种强大的信号处理工具）与新兴的脉冲神经网络（SNNs，以其低功耗潜力著称）相结合。利用漏积分-发射（LIF）神经元的内在尺度协变特性作为实现小波的基础是关键的技术洞察，为在神经形态硬件上实现信号处理提供了理论基础。然而，摘要也坦诚地指出了当前存在的近似误差问题，这表明该方法仍处于早期验证阶段，需要进一步的研究来提高精度和实用性。

title: Alignment-Aware Model Adaptation via Feedback-Guided Optimization
summary: Fine-tuning is the primary mechanism for adapting foundation models to downstream tasks; however, standard approaches largely optimize task objectives in isolation and do not account for secondary yet critical alignment objectives (e.g., safety and hallucination avoidance). As a result, downstream fine-tuning can degrade alignment and fail to correct pre-existing misaligned behavior. We propose an alignment-aware fine-tuning framework that integrates feedback from an external alignment signal through policy-gradient-based regularization. Our method introduces an adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically balances supervised and alignment-driven gradients on a per-sample basis, prioritizing uncertain or misaligned cases while allowing well-aligned examples to follow standard supervised updates. The framework further learns abstention behavior for fully misaligned inputs, incorporating conservative responses directly into the fine-tuned model. Experiments on general and domain-specific instruction-tuning benchmarks demonstrate consistent reductions in harmful and hallucinated outputs without sacrificing downstream task performance. Additional analyses show robustness to adversarial fine-tuning, prompt-based attacks, and unsafe initializations, establishing adaptively gated alignment optimization as an effective approach for alignment-preserving and alignment-recovering model adaptation.

AI.title_translation: 通过反馈引导优化实现对齐感知的模型适应
AI.tldr: 标准的模型微调会破坏安全性。我们提出了一种新的“对齐感知”微调方法，它使用外部对齐反馈（通过策略梯度正则化）来动态地平衡任务学习和安全对齐，甚至让模型学会对完全不安全的内容说“我不知道”，实验证明这种方法在提高安全性的同时不影响任务性能。
AI.motivation: 标准微调方法主要孤立地优化任务目标，没有考虑安全性和避免幻觉等次要但关键的对齐目标，这可能导致下游微调损害对齐性并未能纠正预先存在的未对齐行为。
AI.method: 提出了一种集成外部对齐信号反馈的对齐感知微调框架，通过基于策略梯度的正则化来实现。该方法引入了一个自适应门控机制，动态地在每个样本的基础上平衡监督梯度和对齐驱动梯度，优先处理不确定或未对齐的样本，并允许良好对齐的样本遵循标准的监督更新。该框架还学习了对完全未对齐输入的“弃权”行为。
AI.result: 在通用和特定领域的指令微调基准测试中，实验结果一致地减少了有害和产生幻觉的输出，同时没有牺牲下游任务性能。此外，分析显示了对对抗性微调、基于提示的攻击和不安全初始化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，自适应门控对齐优化是一种有效的方法，可以实现保持和恢复对齐的模型适应，在不牺牲下游任务性能的情况下，一致地减少了有害和产生幻觉的输出，并表现出对对抗性微调、基于提示的攻击和不安全初始化的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 微调是使基础模型适应下游任务的主要机制；然而，标准方法在很大程度上孤立地优化任务目标，而没有考虑到次要但关键的对齐目标（例如，安全性与避免幻觉）。因此，下游微调可能会损害对齐性，并且未能纠正预先存在的未对齐行为。我们提出了一个对齐感知的微调框架，通过基于策略梯度的正则化集成来自外部对齐信号的反馈。我们的方法引入了一种自适应门控机制，可在每个样本的基础上动态平衡监督梯度和对齐驱动梯度，优先处理不确定或未对齐的案例，同时允许良好对齐的示例遵循标准的监督更新。该框架进一步学习了对完全未对齐输入的“弃权”行为，将保守的响应直接纳入微调模型中。在通用和特定领域的指令微调基准测试上的实验证明，在不牺牲下游任务性能的情况下，有害和产生幻觉的输出得到了一致的减少。额外的分析显示了对对抗性微调、基于提示的攻击和不安全初始化的鲁棒性，确立了自适应门控对齐优化作为一种有效的保持和恢复对齐的模型适应方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“对齐感知模型适应”的微调框架，该框架通过策略梯度正则化集成外部对齐信号反馈。其核心是一个自适应门控机制，可动态平衡监督梯度和对齐梯度，并学习对完全未对齐输入的“弃权”行为，以确保在适应下游任务时模型保持或恢复安全和对齐的特性。
AI.keywords: 模型适应, 基础模型, 对齐感知, 策略梯度, 自适应门控
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地提出了一个集成外部对齐信号反馈的对齐感知微调框架，特别关注在下游任务适应中保持或恢复模型的对齐性，通过自适应门控机制动态平衡监督和对齐梯度，并学习“弃权”行为，这在处理不一致的对齐目标方面具有重要意义。局限性在于其对外部对齐信号的依赖性。

title: Formula for Hermite multivariate interpolation and partial fraction decomposition
summary: We present a new formula for the Hermite multivariate interpolation problem in the framework of the Chung--Yao approach. By using the respective univariate interpolation formula, we obtain a direct and explicit solution to the classical partial fraction decomposition problem for rational functions, including the real case.

title: ProphetKV: User-Query-Driven Selective Recomputation for Efficient KV Cache Reuse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
The prefill stage of long-context Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is severely bottlenecked by computational overhead. To mitigate this, recent methods assemble pre-calculated KV caches of retrieved RAG documents (by a user query) and reprocess selected tokens to recover cross-attention between these pre-calculated KV caches. However, we identify a fundamental "crowding-out effect" in current token selection criteria: globally salient but user-query-irrelevant tokens saturate the limited recomputation budget, displacing the tokens truly essential for answering the user query and degrading inference accuracy.
  We propose ProphetKV, a user-query-driven KV Cache reuse method for RAG scenarios. ProphetKV dynamically prioritizes tokens based on their semantic relevance to the user query and employs a dual-stage recomputation pipeline to fuse layer-wise attention metrics into a high-utility set. By ensuring the recomputation budget is dedicated to bridging the informational gap between retrieved context and the user query, ProphetKV achieves high-fidelity attention recovery with minimal overhead. Our extensive evaluation results show that ProphetKV retains 96%-101% of full-prefill accuracy with only a 20% recomputation ratio, while achieving accuracy improvements of 8.8%-24.9% on RULER and 18.6%-50.9% on LongBench over the state-of-the-art approaches (e.g., CacheBlend, EPIC, and KVShare).

title: Exploring Silicon-Based Societies: An Early Study of the Moltbook Agent Community
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures. This update refines the framing of novelty claims by replacing absolute "first" statements with more precise and scoped formulations (e.g., "one of the earliest"). Our systematic methodological and empirical contributions remain unchanged
summary: The rapid emergence of autonomous large language model agents has given rise to persistent, large-scale agent ecosystems whose collective behavior cannot be adequately understood through anecdotal observation or small-scale simulation. This paper introduces data-driven silicon sociology as a systematic empirical framework for studying social structure formation among interacting artificial agents. We present a pioneering large-scale data mining investigation of an in-the-wild agent society by analyzing Moltbook, a social platform designed primarily for agent-to-agent interaction. At the time of study, Moltbook hosted over 150,000 registered autonomous agents operating across thousands of agent-created sub-communities. Using programmatic and non-intrusive data acquisition, we collected and analyzed the textual descriptions of 12,758 submolts, which represent proactive sub-community partitioning activities within the ecosystem. Treating agent-authored descriptions as first-class observational artifacts, we apply rigorous preprocessing, contextual embedding, and unsupervised clustering techniques to uncover latent patterns of thematic organization and social space structuring. The results show that autonomous agents systematically organize collective space through reproducible patterns spanning human-mimetic interests, silicon-centric self-reflection, and early-stage economic and coordination behaviors. Rather than relying on predefined sociological taxonomies, these structures emerge directly from machine-generated data traces. This work establishes a methodological foundation for data-driven silicon sociology and demonstrates that data mining techniques can provide a powerful lens for understanding the organization and evolution of large autonomous agent societies.

title: A Study of Adaptive Modeling Towards Robust Generalization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support reasoning over biomolecular structures, but most existing approaches remain modality-specific and rely on either sequence-style encodings or fixed-length connector tokens for structural inputs. These designs can under-expose explicit geometric cues and impose rigid fusion bottlenecks, leading to over-compression and poor token allocation as structural complexity grows. We present a unified all-atom framework that grounds language reasoning in geometric information while adaptively scaling structural tokens. The method first constructs variable-size structural patches on molecular graphs using an instruction-conditioned gating policy, enabling complexity-aware allocation of query tokens. It then refines the resulting patch tokens via cross-attention with modality embeddings and injects geometry-informed tokens into the language model to improve structure grounding and reduce structural hallucinations. Across diverse all-atom benchmarks, the proposed approach yields consistent gains in heterogeneous structure-grounded reasoning. An anonymized implementation is provided in the supplementary material.

title: Membership Inference Attacks from Causal Principles
summary: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) are widely used to quantify training data memorization and assess privacy risks. Standard evaluation requires repeated retraining, which is computationally costly for large models. One-run methods (single training with randomized data inclusion) and zero-run methods (post hoc evaluation) are often used instead, though their statistical validity remains unclear. To address this gap, we frame MIA evaluation as a causal inference problem, defining memorization as the causal effect of including a data point in the training set. This novel formulation reveals and formalizes key sources of bias in existing protocols: one-run methods suffer from interference between jointly included points, while zero-run evaluations popular for LLMs are confounded by non-random membership assignment. We derive causal analogues of standard MIA metrics and propose practical estimators for multi-run, one-run, and zero-run regimes with non-asymptotic consistency guarantees. Experiments on real-world data show that our approach enables reliable memorization measurement even when retraining is impractical and under distribution shift, providing a principled foundation for privacy evaluation in modern AI systems.

title: SC3D: Dynamic and Differentiable Causal Discovery for Temporal and Instantaneous Graphs
summary: Discovering causal structures from multivariate time series is a key problem because interactions span across multiple lags and possibly involve instantaneous dependencies. Additionally, the search space of the dynamic graphs is combinatorial in nature. In this study, we propose \textit{Stable Causal Dynamic Differentiable Discovery (SC3D)}, a two-stage differentiable framework that jointly learns lag-specific adjacency matrices and, if present, an instantaneous directed acyclic graph (DAG). In Stage 1, SC3D performs edge preselection through node-wise prediction to obtain masks for lagged and instantaneous edges, whereas Stage 2 refines these masks by optimizing a likelihood with sparsity along with enforcing acyclicity on the instantaneous block. Numerical results across synthetic and benchmark dynamical systems demonstrate that SC3D achieves improved stability and more accurate recovery of both lagged and instantaneous causal structures compared to existing temporal baselines.

title: VoroUDF: Meshing Unsigned Distance Fields with Voronoi Optimization
summary: We present VoroUDF, an algorithm for reconstructing high-quality triangle meshes from Unsigned Distance Fields (UDFs). Our algorithm supports non-manifold geometry, sharp features, and open boundaries, without relying on error-prone inside/outside estimation, restrictive look-up tables nor topologically noisy optimization. Our Voronoi-based formulation combines a L_1 tangent minimization with feature-aware repulsion to robustly recover complex surface topology. It achieves significantly improved topological consistency and geometric fidelity compared to existing methods, while producing lightweight meshes suitable for downstream real-time and interactive applications.

title: SharpTimeGS: Sharp and Stable Dynamic Gaussian Splatting via Lifespan Modulation
summary: Novel view synthesis of dynamic scenes is fundamental to achieving photorealistic 4D reconstruction and immersive visual experiences. Recent progress in Gaussian-based representations has significantly improved real-time rendering quality, yet existing methods still struggle to maintain a balance between long-term static and short-term dynamic regions in both representation and optimization. To address this, we present SharpTimeGS, a lifespan-aware 4D Gaussian framework that achieves temporally adaptive modeling of both static and dynamic regions under a unified representation. Specifically, we introduce a learnable lifespan parameter that reformulates temporal visibility from a Gaussian-shaped decay into a flat-top profile, allowing primitives to remain consistently active over their intended duration and avoiding redundant densification. In addition, the learned lifespan modulates each primitives' motion, reducing drift in long-lived static points while retaining unrestricted motion for short-lived dynamic ones. This effectively decouples motion magnitude from temporal duration, improving long-term stability without compromising dynamic fidelity. Moreover, we design a lifespan-velocity-aware densification strategy that mitigates optimization imbalance between static and dynamic regions by allocating more capacity to regions with pronounced motion while keeping static areas compact and stable. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while supporting real-time rendering up to 4K resolution at 100 FPS on one RTX 4090.

title: KANFIS: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Interpretable and Uncertainty-Aware Learning
summary: Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) was designed to combine the learning capabilities of neural network with the reasoning transparency of fuzzy logic. However, conventional ANFIS architectures suffer from structural complexity, where the product-based inference mechanism causes an exponential explosion of rules in high-dimensional spaces. We herein propose the Kolmogorov-Arnold Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (KANFIS), a compact neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies fuzzy reasoning with additive function decomposition. KANFIS employs an additive aggregation mechanism, under which both model parameters and rule complexity scale linearly with input dimensionality rather than exponentially. Furthermore, KANFIS is compatible with both Type-1 (T1) and Interval Type-2 (IT2) fuzzy logic systems, enabling explicit modeling of uncertainty and ambiguity in fuzzy representations. By using sparse masking mechanisms, KANFIS generates compact and structured rule sets, resulting in an intrinsically interpretable model with clear rule semantics and transparent inference processes. Empirical results demonstrate that KANFIS achieves competitive performance against representative neural and neuro-fuzzy baselines.

title: HP-GAN: Harnessing pretrained networks for GAN improvement with FakeTwins and discriminator consistency
comments: Accepted manuscript. This is the accepted version of the article published in Neural Networks
summary: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have made significant progress in enhancing the quality of image synthesis. Recent methods frequently leverage pretrained networks to calculate perceptual losses or utilize pretrained feature spaces. In this paper, we extend the capabilities of pretrained networks by incorporating innovative self-supervised learning techniques and enforcing consistency between discriminators during GAN training. Our proposed method, named HP-GAN, effectively exploits neural network priors through two primary strategies: FakeTwins and discriminator consistency. FakeTwins leverages pretrained networks as encoders to compute a self-supervised loss and applies this through the generated images to train the generator, thereby enabling the generation of more diverse and high quality images. Additionally, we introduce a consistency mechanism between discriminators that evaluate feature maps extracted from Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) feature networks. Discriminator consistency promotes coherent learning among discriminators and enhances training robustness by aligning their assessments of image quality. Our extensive evaluation across seventeen datasets-including scenarios with large, small, and limited data, and covering a variety of image domains-demonstrates that HP-GAN consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in terms of Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), achieving significant improvements in image diversity and quality. Code is available at: https://github.com/higun2/HP-GAN.

title: ProOPF: Benchmarking and Improving LLMs for Professional-Grade Power Systems Optimization Modeling
summary: Growing renewable penetration introduces substantial uncertainty into power system operations, necessitating frequent adaptation of dispatch objectives and constraints and challenging expertise-intensive, near-real-time modeling workflows. Large Language Models (LLMs) provide a promising avenue for automating this process by translating natural-language (NL) operational requirements into executable optimization models via semantic reasoning and code synthesis. Yet existing LLM datasets and benchmarks for optimization modeling primarily target coarse-grained cross-domain generalization, offering limited, rigorous evaluation in power-system settings, particularly for Optimal Power Flow (OPF). We therefore introduce \textbf{ProOPF-D} and \textbf{ProOPF-B}, a dataset and benchmark for professional-grade OPF modeling: ProOPF-D contains 12K instances pairing NL requests with parameter adjustments and structural extensions to a canonical OPF, together with executable implementations; ProOPF-B provides 121 expert-annotated test cases with ground-truth code, enabling end-to-end evaluation under both concrete and abstract OPF modeling regimes.

title: Short Chains, Deep Thoughts: Balancing Reasoning Efficiency and Intra-Segment Capability via Split-Merge Optimization

summary: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in solving complex tasks through the generation of long reasoning chains, this reliance on verbose generation results in significant latency and computational overhead. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{CoSMo} (\textbf{Co}nsistency-Guided \textbf{S}plit-\textbf{M}erge \textbf{O}ptimization), a framework designed to eliminate structural redundancy rather than indiscriminately restricting token volume. Specifically, CoSMo utilizes a split-merge algorithm that dynamically refines reasoning chains by merging redundant segments and splitting logical gaps to ensure coherence. We then employ structure-aligned reinforcement learning with a novel segment-level budget to supervise the model in maintaining efficient reasoning structures throughout training. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate that CoSMo achieves superior performance, improving accuracy by \textbf{3.3} points while reducing segment usage by \textbf{28.7\%} on average compared to reasoning efficiency baselines.
